title: Business Cardholder Courtesy Credit on Closure Refunds
content:
**Cardholder courtesy.** Under the Business closure schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, a business holding a Northgate Business card account in active status on Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.) receives a courtesy credit added to the Business refund. One month's share of the fee is the fee divided by the paid term in months.

| Business's Northgate Card account | Status | Added to the Business refund |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Mastercard | active | one month's share multiplied by 0.25 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | active | one month's share multiplied by 0.125 |
| any other tier, an account not in active status, or no account | — | nothing |

The credit is added before the Business refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

**Hypothetical illustration (fee 120.00 on a 12-month term, one month's share 10.00).** An active Northgate Business Mastercard adds 2.50; an active Northgate Business Store Card adds 1.25.
